Data overflow processing

By default, all Now Assist traffic is managed within ServiceNow datacenters. In the event of traffic spikes, the system is designed to automatically burst to Microsoft Azure datacenters, ensuring consistent performance. You have the choice to opt-out of this feature to keep all Now Assist traffic within ServiceNow datacenters instead. However, opting out could result in processing delays or capacity overflow errors during high traffic periods. Only users with the Data Steward role can opt out of bursting.
